original_context_note: Warm repair from baseline.json by explicit patches only. The full_target is unchanged and equals target-selection.json/full_target verbatim; H001–H003 retain T>0, 0<gamma<=1 and R>0, while the original datum, reality, zero-mean, radius and timestep conditions remain under their universal binders in P. D001–D023 and every original output and graph edge are preserved. D012 is a solution convention, not an existence premise; R001 proves existence. D022 is guarded by H002, which is supplied wherever used. D023 gives step formulas without granting continuity or residual bounds; R008–R011 prove those assertions. D024–D025 add only the actual Li–Wu spatial norm definitions and common Fourier coordinate; R006/R007 S001 prove their carrier and norm identifications. Primary readback obtained the identical 50-page Li–Wu PDF (e71452d13d7d54b902c6d79a08bbcd68edab795f0a59366fff14399b98192f9b), checked its pp.6–8 definitions/product estimate, Proposition 3.4, Lemma 7.2 and exact update/remainder identities. The identical arXiv:0910.1389v2 primary PDF was also obtained and the equation/norm conventions and Theorems 4.2–4.3,5.1,6.3–6.5 inspected for E001. New access/document/text receipts are appended to E001–E005; no primary-source deferral is used. The original 14 coherent units are retained: flow; covariance/frequency majorants; dyadic summation; mixed remainder; elementary operators; trilinear and stage source bridges; interpolation; stage and Y estimates; residual; restarted stability; bootstrap; density. The stability unit R012 is necessarily longer because both endpoints and the actual forcing calculation must be kept together. The acyclic AND graph has unique producers, every non-H reaches P and all three original H are used. The numerical experiments in problem.md Section 5 and the independent discussion are outside the analytical target's proof route and are not imported as proof premises; every calculation and limiting argument needed from Sections 2–4 is retained. These are same-author mathematical closing notes, not an independent Audit A or a claim that structural validation proves the mathematics.
